description: Reverse-solve the Maximum Allowable Offer: the highest purchase price that still meets every return target (defaults: CoC 8%, DSCR 1.20, cash flow ≥ 0; flip: 10% after-tax margin + 15% annualized ROI). Returns the MAO, the binding constraint, and per-target price ceilings. Strategies: ltr, str, brrr, multifamily, flip. Provide the deal inputs WITHOUT committing to a price (use arv or an asking price as reference). Override targets via the targets object. All rates/percents are FRACTIONS (0.0675 = 6.75%). Omitted operating inputs are filled with documented defaults and listed in assumptions.estimated_fields. Free, no key.

inputs.description: Deal inputs in camelCase engine keys. Anything omitted gets a documented default, listed back under assumptions.estimated_fields. price is optional here — the asking price or ARV anchors the price-derived defaults while the solver searches.

adr.description: Average nightly rate in dollars. Required for str.

arv.description: After-repair value in dollars. Required for brrr and flip.

btsArv.description: Finished build-to-sell value in dollars. Required for newc.

buildPsf.description: Build cost per square foot in dollars. Required for newc.

downPct.description: Down payment. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Optional — a documented default applies.

landPrice.description: Land acquisition cost in dollars. Required for newc.

livingSqft.description: Heated living area in square feet. Required for newc.

marketRent.description: Expected monthly rent in dollars. Required for ltr and brrr.

occupancy.description: Expected occupancy. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Required for str.

price.description: Purchase price in dollars. Required for every strategy except newc.

rate.description: Annual interest rate. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Optional.

rehabBudget.description: Renovation budget in dollars. Required for brrr and flip.

taxes.description: Annual property taxes in dollars. Optional.

units.description: Multifamily rent roll — {unitCount, avgRent, marketRent?} or an array of unit objects. Required for multifamily.

vacancyPct.description: Vacancy allowance. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent. Optional.

targets.description: Return targets the price must still satisfy. Omit to use each strategy's defaults.

afterTaxAnnualROI.description: Flip: minimum annualized after-tax ROI. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent.

afterTaxMargin.description: Flip: minimum after-tax profit margin. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent.

capitalRecovery.description: BRRRR: minimum share of invested cash returned at refi. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent.

cocReturn.description: Minimum cash-on-cash return. Expressed as a FRACTION (0.0675 = 6.75%), never a percent.

monthlyCF.description: Minimum monthly cash flow in dollars.
